+import io
+import pytest
+from gitseed.review.approval import collect_approval, NotInteractive
+
+
+class MockTTY(io.StringIO):
+    """StringIO with isatty() method that returns True."""
+    def isatty(self):
+        return True
+
+
+class MockNonTTY(io.StringIO):
+    """StringIO with isatty() method that returns False."""
+    def isatty(self):
+        return False
+
+
+def test_collect_approval_accepts_y():
+    """Test that 'y' input returns True and writes the prompt."""
+    stdin = MockTTY("y\n")
+    stdout = MockTTY()
+
+    result = collect_approval(stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout)
+
+    assert result is True
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == "approve? [y/N] "
+
+
+def test_collect_approval_accepts_Y_uppercase():
+    """Test that 'Y' input (uppercase) returns True after lowercasing."""
+    stdin = MockTTY("Y\n")
+    stdout = MockTTY()
+
+    result = collect_approval(stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout)
+
+    assert result is True
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == "approve? [y/N] "
+
+
+def test_collect_approval_declines_empty():
+    """Test that empty input (just newline) returns False."""
+    stdin = MockTTY("\n")
+    stdout = MockTTY()
+
+    result = collect_approval(stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout)
+
+    assert result is False
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == "approve? [y/N] "
+
+
+def test_collect_approval_declines_n():
+    """Test that 'n' input returns False."""
+    stdin = MockTTY("n\n")
+    stdout = MockTTY()
+
+    result = collect_approval(stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout)
+
+    assert result is False
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == "approve? [y/N] "
+
+
+def test_collect_approval_declines_no():
+    """Test that 'no' input returns False."""
+    stdin = MockTTY("no\n")
+    stdout = MockTTY()
+
+    result = collect_approval(stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout)
+
+    assert result is False
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == "approve? [y/N] "
+
+
+def test_collect_approval_declines_arbitrary_input():
+    """Test that arbitrary non-'y' input returns False."""
+    stdin = MockTTY("anything else\n")
+    stdout = MockTTY()
+
+    result = collect_approval(stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout)
+
+    assert result is False
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == "approve? [y/N] "
+
+
+def test_collect_approval_strips_whitespace():
+    """Test that leading/trailing whitespace is stripped."""
+    stdin = MockTTY("  y  \n")
+    stdout = MockTTY()
+
+    result = collect_approval(stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout)
+
+    assert result is True
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == "approve? [y/N] "
+
+
+def test_collect_approval_not_interactive_raises_exception():
+    """Test that non-tty stdin raises NotInteractive exception."""
+    stdin = MockNonTTY("y\n")
+    stdout = MockTTY()
+
+    with pytest.raises(NotInteractive, match="approval requires a terminal"):
+        collect_approval(stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout)
